product.description: Monoprice™EZ™ Series Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount BracketEasy‑to‑install wall Mount with cable management for most 23" to 42" displaysThe Monoprice™ EZ™ Series Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket has an elegant design meant for easy installation. It includes cable management covers, which allow you to hide the cables for a clean, organized appearance. It is designed to easily mount most small to medium screen TVs from 23" to 42", with VESA® patterns ranging from 75x75 to 200x200 and weighing up to 66 lbs. It also allows for a wide range of motion to swivel and tilt the display, resulting in a comfortable viewing angle, no matter where you choose to sit. This versatile wall mount can fit both curved screen and flat screen displays.Fits VESA® patterns from 75x75 to 200x200Includes cable management coversDesigned for 23" to 42" displaysSupports up to 66 lbs.±90° swivel range±20° tilt range3.5" to 18.3" extension rangeFits both flat screen and curved screen displays FULL‑MOTION ARTICULATING WALL MOUNTMonoprice full‑motion wall mounts offer the ultimate in comfort and flexibility. The articulated swing arm allows you to pull the TV away from or push it towards the wall, tilt it up or down, and angle it from side to side. CABLE MANAGEMENT COVERSThis full‑motion wall mount includes decorative and convenient cable management covers, which allow you to hide the cables for a clean, organized appearance. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern or measure the horizontal and vertical distances between the mounting holes (in mm).This mount supports VESA patterns between 75x75 and 200x200.This mount supports TVs weighing up to 66 pounds.The screen size range is only a suggested approximation. Your TV is compatible as long as its VESA mounting pattern is between 75x75 and 200x200 and it weighs no more than 66 pounds. STATE‑OF‑THE‑ART STEEL CONSTRUCTIONThis Monoprice™ EZ™ Series Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket is constructed from high‑quality, cold‑rolled steel, which gives it a strong, heavy‑duty build, capable of supporting up to 66 pounds. Its new design also features a lighter build compared to older, more bulky mounts. This mount can be easily mounted to brick, concrete, or wood stud walls. ACCESSORIES INCLUDEDTo make your mounting experience as simple and complete as possible, Monoprice™ EZ™ Series wall mounts include a number of practical accessories and tools to make the job easier, including a carpenters' level, a cut‑out template, a Monoprice HDMI® cable, and Monoprice hook‑and‑loop cable ties.    *The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations.
